# Graph navigation prototype

This directory contains a fish-eye graph navigation prototype and supporting assets. It is exploratory material, not the production record-navigation contract or a claim of a shipped universal graph explorer.

Use it to investigate focus, context, transitions, and readable labels. Any product integration must preserve authorized navigation, named destinations, keyboard use, narrow-screen behavior, and performance on representative graph sizes.

The production experience uses the registered views and resource pages described in the [user guide](../../docs/user-guide/README.md). Prototype visuals cannot establish backend permission or traversal correctness.
